description: 🚀 Engram-PEFT: An unofficial implementation of DeepSeek Engram. Inject high-capacity conditional memory into LLMs via sparse retrieval PEFT without increasing inference FLOPs / DeepSeek Engram 架构的非官方实现。通过参数高效微调 (PEFT) 为大语言模型注入超大规模条件记忆，支持稀疏更新且不增加推理开销。
